title: Exact cohomology ladder for the internal-Hom filtered-colimit comparison
statement:
Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a ringed site small in the chosen universe, with $\mathcal O$ commutative [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-size-convention]. Put $\mathcal M=\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ and use its ordinary unbounded derived category $D(\mathcal M)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Fix the functorial K-injective target models for $H(A,N)=R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}(A,N)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom, def-sfb-internal-hom-strict-models]. For any small filtered diagram $N:I\to\operatorname{CoCh}(\mathcal M)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], put $N_\infty=\varinjlim_iN_i$ termwise and let $\alpha_A:\varinjlim_iH(A,N_i)\to H(A,N_\infty)$ be the image in $D(\mathcal M)$ of the canonical complex cocone map on these models. All colimits here are termwise sheaf colimits. For every small filtered complex diagram $(K_i)$ and $q\in\mathbf Z$, there is a natural isomorphism
$$H^q(\varinjlim_iK_i)\cong\varinjlim_iH^q(K_i).$$
Consequently termwise filtered colimits preserve quasi-isomorphisms and common cohomological lower bounds. Let $A\xrightarrow u B\xrightarrow v C\xrightarrow w A[1]$ be any distinguished triangle [def-weil-triangulated-category]. For every $q\in\mathbf Z$, the sequences
$$\cdots\to\varinjlim_iH^{q-1}(H(A,N_i))\to\varinjlim_iH^q(H(C,N_i))\to\varinjlim_iH^q(H(B,N_i))\to\varinjlim_iH^q(H(A,N_i))\to\varinjlim_iH^{q+1}(H(C,N_i))\to\cdots$$
and
$$\cdots\to H^{q-1}(H(A,N_\infty))\to H^q(H(C,N_\infty))\to H^q(H(B,N_\infty))\to H^q(H(A,N_\infty))\to H^{q+1}(H(C,N_\infty))\to\cdots$$
are exact, and form a commuting ladder whose vertical arrows at $X=A,B,C$ are $H^q(\alpha_X)$ under the displayed cohomology-colimit identification. The arrows in both rows are those induced by precomposition with $u,v,w$; for $w$ one uses the signed source-shift comparison $H(A[1],N)\cong H(A,N)[-1]$ (cochain convention $K[n]^q=K^{q+n}$, $d_{K[n]}=(-1)^nd_K$), which on the Hom-complex models reindexes components and multiplies degree-$q$ components by $(-1)^q$, independently of $N$. Commutativity includes every connecting square, with these specified signs. No boundedness, continuity or constructibility assumption is imposed on $A,B,C$ or $N$.
